A tanker truck carrying liquefied natural gas exploded in Sichuan province, located in southwest China.
The incident was captured on several CCTV cameras.
Footage published online shows workers being doused with the contents of the tank.
As the men try to escape, an explosion occurs.
According to preliminary data, two people became victims of the incident, and two more were injured.
It is noted that, by a happy coincidence, the fire did not hit the gas station.
